title: Revision HQ 2: lessons 9 to 13
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Revision HQ 2
objectives: know which lessons I am secure on and which to revise
be ready for the end-of-unit assessment
starter: Without notes, list as many key terms from lessons 9 to 13 as you can in two minutes.

stations.name: Lesson 9: Modes of connection
stations.challenge: Which is better: a wired or wireless network?

logic.title: Which connection has a range of about 10 metres and low power use?
Which is an advantage of a wired connection?
What does Ethernet send data in?

stations.name: Lesson 10: Wi-Fi encryption
stations.challenge: What is the purpose of encryption?

logic.title: Why is encryption needed on Wi-Fi?
Which key must never be shared?
What does WPA2 do before data is sent?

stations.name: Lesson 11: IP and MAC addressing
stations.challenge: What are the differences between the three types of address?

logic.title: Which address does a switch use?
Which protocol sends email to a mail server?
What does HTTPS add to HTTP?

stations.name: Lesson 13: Layers
stations.challenge: What are the benefits of layering protocols?

logic.title: Which is an advantage of layering?
Which layer does Wi-Fi belong to?

stations.name: Exam technique
stations.challenge: Which command word needs you to give a reason?

logic.title: A question says 'Explain'. What do you need to include?
How many points should you aim for in a 4-mark question?
A question says 'State'. What is expected?

final.title: Final challenge: key terms
final.instr: write what each one matches with.

keyq: Which parts of this topic could I explain to somebody else, and which can I only recognise?
exam: Explain one advantage of using IPv6 instead of IPv4.
Describe how public and private keys are used.
